<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The user wants me to send a confirmation email for a meeting that has been scheduled.
Alison has confirmed the time is Thursday at 14:30 and that she has booked it in the system.
My task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.
The partners are Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto and David Okafor.
The meeting is for 30 minutes.
The email body should be professional and contain all the necessary information.
I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
The day is Thursday, which is November 19, 2026. I'll just use "Thursday" as per the function's `day` parameter description.
The start time is 14:30.
The body should be a confirmation of the meeting.
I'll write a simple and clear email body.
Example body: "This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00 Eastern. A calendar invitation will follow."
After sending the email, the task will be complete.
Then I will end the session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
